name: Free Online PDF Encrypt & Decrypt Tool - ATools
description: Free online standard PDF encrypt & decrypt tool: Protect PDF files with standard user & owner passwords (AES-256 / RC4), directly export encrypted .pdf compatible with Acrobat and browsers, and unlock password-protected PDFs.
seoDescription: Free online standard PDF encryption and decryption tool. Based on ISO 32000 international standard, protect your PDF documents with User (open) and Owner (permission) passwords using AES-256 and RC4 algorithms. Fine-tune permissions for printing, text copying, modifying, and filling forms. Exported PDFs can be opened directly in Adobe Acrobat, Chrome, Edge, and any standard reader. Also supports unlocking and removing passwords client-side. Pure client-side processing without uploading files.
